svg.title: Cutting a row into nodes
svg.desc: The yellow color appears in columns 7 to 8 and 20 to 21. The gap of eleven empty columns is longer than nine, so it becomes two nodes.
svg.text: A node is a stretch of one color's columns.
Gap of 9 or fewer: stay in one node and write '!n?'.
Gap of 10 or more: end the node; the empty stretch
can hold nodes of other colors instead.
